source_note: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分
english_source_note: Integrating via Binary Expansion of the Variable
callout_id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#3
english_title: Proposition 1: Binary Expansion of a Uniformly Distributed Random Variable
statement_en: Let \\(X_1,X_2,\\dots\\) be random variables on a probability space \\((\\Omega,\\mathcal F,P)\\), and define $$Y(\\omega):=\\sum_{n\\geq 1}\\frac{X_n(\\omega)}{2^n}.$$ Then: 1. If \\(X_k\\sim U(\\{0,1\\})\\) are independent and identically distributed, then \\(Y\\sim U(0,1)\\). 2. Conversely, if \\(Y\\sim U(0,1)\\), then the binary digits \\(X_k\\) form an independent and identically distributed sequence with \\(X_k\\sim U(\\{0,1\\})\\).
callout_body:
令$X_1,...,X_n,...$是概率空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$当中的一列随机变量，定义$$Y(\omega):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{X_n(\omega)}{2^n}$$那么
1. 如果$X_k \sim U(\{0,1\})$是一列独立同分布的随机变量,那么$Y\sim U(0,1)$是一个均匀分布的随机变量。
3. 如果$Y\sim U(0,1)$那么$X_k\sim$是一列独立同分布的且满足$X_k \sim U(\{0,1\})$的随机变量。
